title: MikroTrick Chain Let Attackers Take Over MikroTik Routers Without a Password or SSH Key
summary: Two MikroTik RouterOS SSH vulnerabilities chained together let attackers take full administrative control of Internet-exposed routers without a password, SSH key, or completed authentication.
card_summary: Two MikroTik RouterOS SSH vulnerabilities chained together let attackers take full administrative control of Internet-exposed routers without a password, SSH key, or completed authentication.

sections.technical:
The chain, which CERT Polska calls MikroTrick, combines an SSH state-machine flaw (CVE-2026-67279) with an argument-injection bug in the RouterOS login process (CVE-2026-86060).

Referenced vulnerabilities: CVE-2026-67279, CVE-2026-86060.

email_summary: Two MikroTik RouterOS SSH vulnerabilities chained together let attackers take full administrative control of Internet-exposed routers without a password, SSH key, or completed authentication. Tracked as CVE-2026-67279, CVE-2026-86060.
